key_findings.finding: card1=9633 carries a 16.69% mature (chargeback-window-settled) fraud rate over 3,883 prior transactions — ~4.8x the ~3.5% base rate — independently corroborating the GBDT score rather than relying on it.
card1+email combination shows an even higher 24.29% mature fraud rate, reinforcing that the current gmail.com pairing is high-risk despite gmail's own benign base rate.
Entity exhibits a textbook gang/mule topology: gang_score=1.0, device fan-out of 372, spanning 28 addr1 and 17 emails on a single card1.
ProductCD=C has an 11.39% mature fraud rate (3.2x base), and the transaction matches the high-lift entity-fraud rules R_PRIOR_FRAUD_CARD1_EMAIL (19.11%) and R_PRIOR_FRAUD_CARD1 (17.32%).

The current txn's profile (visa/debit, gmail.com, Samsung mobile, ProductCD=C, card1=9633, small ~$81 amount) is a near-match to confirmed-fraud case #3456924 (chargeback-confirmed on the same card1).

Conflict/caveat: the same card1=9633 profile was human-cleared as high-score false-positive in cases #3418774/#3418760/#3398149 — but those clearances predated the now-matured 16.69% card-level fraud label and occurred at much lower model scores (0.41-0.59). The matured entity history now decisively favors fraud; the GBDT p=0.9957 is corroborated but this profile has historically produced FPs, so entity-level evidence (not the score) is the deciding factor.

gang_association.rationale: gang_score=1.0 with device fan-out 372 across 28 addr1 and 17 emails, plus a matured 16.69% card-level (24.29% card+email) fraud rate over 3,883 prior txns, indicates a coordinated mule/gang operation centered on card1=9633.

report.disposition_rationale: Despite the small $81 amount, strong gang evidence (gang_score=1.0, fan-out 372, matured 16.69%+ entity fraud rate) means freezing/building a case on card1=9633 prevents batch fraud, making escalation ($40) net-beneficial versus a per-transaction decline that ignores the coordinated entity.
report.summary: Transaction 3528434 ($81.34, ProductCD=C, visa/debit, gmail.com, Samsung mobile) rides on card1=9633, an entity with a matured 16.69% fraud rate over 3,883 prior transactions (24.29% when paired with email) and an unambiguous gang topology (gang_score=1.0, device fan-out 372 across 28 addresses and 17 emails). Multiple high-lift rules fire and the profile closely matches chargeback-confirmed fraud case #3456924 on the same card. While the identical profile was previously human-cleared as false-positive, those clearances predated the matured fraud label and came at low model scores; the GBDT p=0.9957 is here independently corroborated by hard entity-level evidence. Given the coordinated gang footprint, escalation to freeze/build a case on card1=9633 is recommended over a single decline, as it stops future batch fraud at low cost.
